name: Documenso
description: Documenso is an open, transparent digital signing platform. It provides a clean document signing workflow with roles, audit logs, and a public API, positioning itself as a credible open alternative to closed commercial signing tools. Self-hostable and built for teams that care about who holds the keys to their signatures.
highlights: Full signing workflow with roles and status
Audit logs for every document event
Public API and webhooks for integration
curatorNote: Digital signing is an industry dominated by closed products. Documenso is one of the few open efforts with production polish and a clear path forward.
